content: {"episode_id":"ep-05084","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-97 denial of CPT 93271, the cardiac event monitoring study ordered for this episode. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction, consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes Z86.73, G45.9, and I48.0. As stated in the note, the study was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of these transient cerebral ischemic events and guide anticoagulation management. On this documented indication, CPT 93271 is medically necessary and we request reprocessing of the outstanding balance of 349.19."}
